text: 1. Front page of the passport. 2. Highest educational qualification certificate. If the applicant is a student, a pre-graduation certificate or a student status certificate issued by the school where he/she is studying must be submitted. 3. Academic Transcript. The scanned copy of the transcript should include the highest academic stage and the grades up to the most recent semester. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese or English translation and notarization are required. 4. Recommendation Letters. Two recommendation letters, written in either Chinese or English. 5. Study Plan in China. The study plan should be written in either Chinese or English and must be no less than 300 words. 6. Other academic ability certificates or proof of participation in social activities. 7. Language proficiency certificates, such as HSK certificates, IELTS/TOEFL/ Duolingo test scores, or official English teaching certification. 8. "Foreigner Physical Examination Record Form". It should be filled out in Chinese or English. Download link: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2118.htm. 9. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese/English translation and notarization must be provided as well.
